rule: A site is used to fill a chart gap only when its terms of use and its robots.txt both allow automated access. Terms are checked once (date below). robots.txt is re-checked each night by scripts/check-fill-robots.mjs. Bot blocks are never bypassed. Requests are throttled to 1 every 10 seconds or the site's Crawl-delay, whichever is longer. Filled points carry source tag 'f' internally and are named in the chart's About note.
